notes: Telemetry is now pushed to each panel window at the rate that window actually redraws, instead of once a second regardless. A theme declares its cadence; Mirage declares 5 seconds. A theme that declares nothing keeps receiving every frame…
The clock cannot drift as a result: however slow a declared cadence, the push fires early whenever the wall-clock minute rolls over, so a minute display is never late.
A window that is not due for an update now costs nothing at all -- the snapshot is not even built if no window is due for that frame.
